functions.name: WithPostgres
functions.returns: An updated resource builder with Postgres integration configured for the Keycloak resource.

parameters.name: database
parameters.description: The resource builder for the Postgres database that Keycloak will connect to.

fields.name: Username
fields.description: (Optional) The resource builder for the parameter defining the database username. If not provided, the parent database resource's username parameter will be used.

fields.name: Password
fields.description: (Optional) The resource builder for the parameter defining the database password. If not provided, the parent database resource's password parameter will be used.

fields.name: XaEnabled
fields.description: A boolean flag indicating whether XA transactions are enabled. Defaults to false.
